title: The snag
logline: A dead cedar standing alone in the cut below the ridge, December, and the glow behind it making it a black shape with a lit edge. The one thing the sequence draws that the strip drew in 2002 — the same snag, from the same road.

panels.composition: A dead cedar snag standing alone in a clear-cut below a wooded ridge at dusk, backlit by a warm glow so its trunk is black with a lit edge, the gravel road curving past it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a dead cedar snag standing alone in a clear-cut below a wooded ridge at dusk backlit by a warm glow so its trunk is black with a lit edge, a gravel road curving past, no words
